_meta._chest_spawn_note: MIRROR ONLY — NOT THE SOURCE OF TRUTH. ChestSpawner calls Constants.chest_spawn_chance(), which reads Constants.CHEST_BASE_SPAWN. Nothing reads this file at runtime any more — the special_item_spawn_rates block was the only reason DataLoader's copy was ever consulted, and it is gone. This block is kept in sync purely so the file does not mislead. 2026-07-31: base 0.8 -> 0.6 (-25%) at explicit user request, chests spawned too often; per-layer 0.800/0.512/0.288/0.128 -> 0.600/0.384/0.216/0.096. The squared depth falloff is unchanged, so every layer scaled by the same 0.75. If you change the rate, change Constants.CHEST_BASE_SPAWN and update this mirror to match.
